part1_tcl_haier_reference_classification.standard_applied: the SAME standard used throughout Phase 3: a canonical needs 2+ INDEPENDENT, non-Amazon merchant observations to earn REFERENCE_CLEAN. A single non-Amazon merchant, however internally consistent, is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE — this is the exact bar that classified 5 of the 20 valid-tier canonicals as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE in Phase 3 (ADR-321), applied here without relaxation.

No contradicting evidence was found (unlike the GREE contamination cases), so this is a data-THINNESS finding, not a data-CORRECTNESS finding — but the mission's own bar for 'REFERENCE_CLEAN' requires more than one independent source, and this canonical does not clear it.

part3_rollback_design_not_executed.existing_mechanism_reviewed: storefront_identity_links (scripts/database/knowledge-db/025_storefront_identity_links.sql, ADR-242/312) already implements a proven, rollback-safe write pattern for storefront canonical-linking: UPDATE products SET canonical_product_id=<new> WHERE id=<product> AND canonical_product_id=<prior> (optimistic lock — the update only applies if the row is still in the exact state expected, preventing a race with any other write), with the prior value and full context recorded in a ledger row (status: active/drift/rolled_back), and a --rollback flag that restores canonical_product_id to the ledger's own recorded prior value.
part3_rollback_design_not_executed.critical_incompatibility_found: storefront_identity_links.evidence_class has a CHECK constraint restricted to ('url_exact','asin_exact') only — it was built for the ADR-312 URL/ASIN-exact-match pilot, not for attribute-fingerprint-based candidates like the Rescue Lab produces. Writing a Rescue Lab pilot link through this exact table, unmodified, is not possible without either altering its CHECK constraint (itself a Products 2 schema change requiring separate approval) or conflating fingerprint-based provenance with exact-match provenance in the same audit trail.

RECOMMENDED_DESIGN_not_created_this_phas.approach: a NEW, separate, purpose-built table (e.g. ac_rescue_lab_pilot_links) mirroring storefront_identity_links' safe-write pattern exactly, but physically distinct — so a pilot write/rollback can never touch, be confused with, or accidentally revert an ADR-312 exact-match link.
RECOMMENDED_DESIGN_not_created_this_phas.WHAT_TABLE_RECORD_WOULD_CHANGE: products.canonical_product_id for exactly the pilot's Amazon storefront row(s) — the same single-column write the existing mechanism already uses, nothing else
RECOMMENDED_DESIGN_not_created_this_phas.WHAT_VALUE_EXISTS_BEFORE: NULL (every candidate examined in this lab is currently unlinked at the storefront layer — confirmed via provenance_note in the fingerprint data for every non-'already-linked' case)
RECOMMENDED_DESIGN_not_created_this_phas.WHAT_VALUE_WOULD_EXIST_AFTER: the specific canonical_product_id of the verified rescue candidate
RECOMMENDED_DESIGN_not_created_this_phas.HOW_THE_PILOT_RECORD_IS_IDENTIFIED: a dedicated pilot ledger row keyed by (product_id, canonical_product_id, pilot_batch_id) with an explicit rule_version tag distinguishing it from any other write path (e.g. 'ac-rescue-lab-pilot-v1'), so every pilot-origin link is queryable and filterable independent of any other linking mechanism
RECOMMENDED_DESIGN_not_created_this_phas.HOW_TO_REVERSE_ONLY_THE_PILOT: UPDATE products SET canonical_product_id = NULL WHERE id = ANY(<pilot product_ids>) AND canonical_product_id = ANY(<pilot canonical_ids the pilot itself wrote>) — scoped by the pilot's own ledger, an optimistic-lock guard identical to the existing mechanism's, touching only rows the pilot itself created
RECOMMENDED_DESIGN_not_created_this_phas.HOW_TO_VERIFY_REVERSAL: after rollback, re-query products.canonical_product_id for the exact pilot product_ids and assert NULL; separately assert the pilot ledger's status column reads 'rolled_back' for every pilot row and that no non-pilot storefront_identity_links row was touched (a simple row-count-unchanged check on that table)
RECOMMENDED_DESIGN_not_created_this_phas.HOW_TO_PREVENT_OVERWRITING_PRE_EXISTING_: the write must be gated exactly like the existing mechanism — WHERE canonical_product_id = NULL (or the specific prior value recorded before the pilot ran) — so a pilot write can NEVER fire against a product that already has ANY canonical_product_id set (pre-existing or otherwise); this is directly informed by this phase's own finding that 2 of the 4 candidates were ALREADY linked — a pilot targeting only genuinely NULL rows structurally cannot repeat that confusion
RECOMMENDED_DESIGN_not_created_this_phas.HOW_TO_HANDLE_DRIFT: reuse the existing mechanism's own drift concept (a scheduled recheck comparing the pilot-linked canonical's current identity_key against the value recorded at link time; a mismatch flips the pilot ledger row to 'drift' status, exactly mirroring storefront_identity_links' own drift column, without touching the products table until a human reviews it)
RECOMMENDED_DESIGN_not_created_this_phas.HOW_TO_PRESERVE_AUDIT_HISTORY: never delete or overwrite a pilot ledger row — status transitions only (active -> rolled_back or active -> drift), append-only, matching the project's constitutional rule that identity/provenance records are never destructively modified
properties_confirmed: narrowly scoped (pilot-only table + pilot-only product_id list)
incapable of reverting unrelated Products 2 work (physically separate table from storefront_identity_links, separate rule_version tag, guarded by the pilot's own prior-value ledger)

part5_brand_corruption_scope_only.CUSTOMER_VISIBLE: NO — zero storefront (products/product_stores) rows point at any of the 30 affected canonicals; confirmed by direct query. This defect exists only at the normalized TPS knowledge-layer, never reached a customer-facing page.
part5_brand_corruption_scope_only.MATCHING_IMPACT: any future brand-based filter, search facet, or comparison feature keyed on canonical_products.brand would silently mis-group or drop these 30 rows — they would not appear under 'LG' despite being LG products. Also relevant to future candidate-generation: a rescue-style matcher blocking on brand_canonical would need these repaired (or normalized) before they could ever participate correctly, since 'إل'/'ال'/'مكيف' are excluded by the UNSAFE_BRAND_PLACEHOLDERS-style denylist logic used throughout this lab.
part5_brand_corruption_scope_only.RESCUE_LAB_IMPACT: NONE of the 30 affected canonicals appeared as a candidate anywhere in Run A (confirmed: the Rescue Lab's brand_safe filter structurally excludes any brand not in the recognized-brand list, and 'إل'/'ال'/'مكيف' are not recognized brand tokens) — this defect did not and could not influence any Rescue Lab finding to date, but would need fixing before it could ever safely be included in a widened trusted universe.
part5_brand_corruption_scope_only.scope_conclusion: 30 confirmed instances (up from the 3 known before this scan; also found to extend beyond AC into TV), 0 customer-facing exposure, 0 impact on any Rescue Lab result so far. Scan is READ-ONLY; nothing was fixed.

final_gate.ROLLBACK_READY: DESIGNED, NOT BUILT — the mechanism is fully specified (Part 3) but no table was created and no code was written; 'ready' here means the design exists and reuses a proven pattern, not that it could be executed today
final_gate.ROLLBACK_TESTABLE_WITHOUT_PRODUCTION_WRI: YES — the design's every property (deterministic, narrowly scoped, independently verifiable, incapable of reverting unrelated work) can and should be verified in a non-production or dry-run context before any real write, exactly as every prior write-capable script in this project (e.g. project-storefront-identity.ts) already requires dry-run-first
final_gate.KNOWN_GATE_FAILURE_AFFECTING_THE_4: NO — the Fisher hard-conflict-gate blind spot (ADR-320/321) is confined to a REVIEW-tier GREE-adjacent case and does not touch any of the 4 HIGH_CONFIDENCE candidates or their reference canonicals
final_gate.why_no_pilot_plan: the mission's own rule ('If either is not REFERENCE_CLEAN: STOP the production-pilot proposal') is triggered by both TCL and Haier being INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE rather than REFERENCE_CLEAN. Preparing a 5-product (or even a 2-product) pilot plan now would mean proposing to link products whose reference truth itself was just found to be under-corroborated — exactly the failure mode this whole 4-phase audit exists to prevent. Consistent with the mission's own closing instruction ('a pilot of 2 clean new rescues is preferable to 5 partially justified ones... do not manufacture five'), the honest number of CURRENTLY reference-clean, genuinely-novel rescue candidates is ZERO, not 2 and not 5 — so no pilot plan is prepared at all, of any size.
final_gate.path_to_a_future_YES: strengthen TCL's and Haier's reference corroboration to 2+ independent merchants (this is a data-coverage question, not a V1 logic question — both stores' AC categories are actively scraped, so more merchant coverage may simply require time, or targeted verification against an additional retailer's own product page) OR find other, already-REFERENCE_CLEAN, genuinely-novel rescue candidates elsewhere in the 270-product Amazon AC population that this lab has not yet tried to expand into.
